Attachments: 1) UptickOrbit_MA_plan_v2.pdf — pricing and soft-burst mechanics. 2) SOW_draft.docx — draft scope and term.

- Ops alignment call to walk through QoS: expected 95th pct latency, fallback model mapping, and burst behavior. Karthik will join from infra.
- Finalize DocuSign and invoice timing.

If Dec start works we can prorate Nov usage into the Dec invoice and activate the commit on 12/1.

Thanks,

Alex — I'll follow up with two SOW variants (350M baseline and 400M baseline) and a one-page ops runbook.
